_doc: The Unsealing chapter 10, one against three. Hand-made (tools/maps/build_unsealing_maps.py). The Host comes from the south across the Pale River by two roads and three fords; Highmere, the Concord's eastern fortress, holds the middle of the north side behind ridges with a front and two flank gaps, a Thornwood war-grove the north-west and a Forge hold the north-east. The three are allied computer players (team 1), at the easy difficulty. Laid out on a 36x28 grid and drawn 3.2x larger.
name: The Red Sky Throne
